title: Owner: close the old staging AWS account after confirming leftovers are not needed
description:
Staging moved into the production AWS account and the old staging account's stacks were deleted. Empty leftovers remain: tables, buckets, secrets, queues, Cognito pools, zones, budget. The account itself is not closed. Owner confirms nothing retained is needed, then closes it.

Feature: Old staging account retired
  Scenario: Account closed
    Given leftovers were reviewed
    When the owner closes the account
    Then no staging resources remain outside the production account
right_now_summary: The owner is reviewing leftover staging resources before closing the old AWS account.
